findings.highlight: this is nothing compared to the shadow, but it’s still a hundred times more than my magical energy capacity
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の纏った影に比べたら掌一つ分の魔力ではあるのだが、それでも俺の許容量からすれば何百倍
findings.governingReading: Against the shadow enveloping Sakura it is only a palmful, yet it is hundreds of times Shirou’s capacity.
findings.explanation: The English removes the palmful scale and Sakura’s enveloping relation, then reduces plural hundreds to exactly one hundred.

findings.highlight: let’s go back to your room
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋に戻りましょう
findings.governingReading: Rin proposes returning indoors and heads toward the living room.
findings.explanation: The dialogue invents Shirou’s personal room, immediately contradicting the narrated destination.

findings.highlight: I decide to ask Tohsaka something before I follow.
findings.evidenceJa: はた、とある事を閃いた
findings.governingReading: As he is about to follow Illya, Shirou suddenly thinks of something.
findings.explanation: The English replaces a sudden inspiration with a deliberate decision to ask a question, spoiling the improvised pretext that follows.

findings.highlight: I’m sure the sword was there at that time.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼の魔道翁が手にする剣もちゃんと見ていた筈だもの
findings.governingReading: The inherited record should have clearly seen the sword held by the old man of the Kaleidoscope.
findings.explanation: The English reduces a recorded person holding the sword to the sword merely being present, removing the wielder and observation relation.

findings.highlight: the pressure of two hundred years
findings.evidenceJa: 二百年前の記録へ遡る圧力
findings.governingReading: Shirou will undergo the pressure of tracing backward into a record from two hundred years ago.
findings.explanation: The English turns pressure generated by retrospective movement through the record into the undifferentiated weight of a duration.

findings.highlight: Her arms are as well.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺を正面から抱いたイリヤの腕も、小刻みに震えている
findings.governingReading: Illya’s arms, embracing Shirou directly from the front, are trembling in small increments along with her voice.
findings.explanation: The English preserves trembling arms but removes the frightened embrace and its precise physical relation.

findings.highlight: There’s no pain, the cognition of pain doesn’t matter now, I’m swallowed by my injury, I’m falling into a swirling maelstrom of pain.
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みのない、痛みという認識はもはや該当しない自己の損傷に蝕まれながら、何重にも回転する痛みの中に落ちていく
findings.governingReading: Damage to the self has exceeded the category of pain even as Shirou falls through many rotating layers of pain.
findings.explanation: The comma-spliced English makes pain both absent and irrelevant without preserving the source’s distinction between damage beyond recognition and the layered pain surrounding it.

findings.highlight: the beautiful spider’s nest
findings.evidenceJa: 美しい蜘蛛の巣
findings.governingReading: Justeaze stands at the center of a beautiful spiderweb formed by the circuits.
findings.explanation: The English changes the visual structure from a web to the spider’s nest.

findings.highlight: accompanied by Makiri Zouken and Tohsaka Nagato
findings.evidenceJa: マキリ臓硯と遠坂永人を従えた
findings.governingReading: The great magus praised as the winter saint had Makiri Zouken and Tohsaka Nagato in attendance or under her leadership.
findings.explanation: “Accompanied by” removes Justeaze’s superior directional relation over the two founders.

findings.highlight: The old man knows as well as Makiri and Tohsaka do that the Holy Grail is a mere wishbringer.
findings.evidenceJa: マキリや遠坂だけでは、聖杯はただの願望機にすぎない事を、その老人はよく知っていた
findings.governingReading: The old man knew well that with Makiri and Tohsaka alone, the Grail would be no more than a wish-granting device.
findings.explanation: The English makes Makiri and Tohsaka fellow knowers instead of the insufficient founders in the proposition the old man knows.

findings.highlight: I did, so my body was ripped in half.
findings.evidenceJa: 意識を割いたから、体が半分になった
findings.governingReading: Within the inherited-record experience, diverting awareness makes Shirou’s perceived body or viewpoint shrink by half.
findings.explanation: “Ripped in half” promotes the altered self-perception into a literal catastrophic bodily injury and adds violent tearing.

findings.highlight: the man standing in front of the Great Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 大聖杯を眼下に見据え、事の顛末を見守る一人の老人
findings.governingReading: One old man overlooks the Greater Grail below and watches the course of events.
findings.explanation: The English relocates him in front of the Grail and removes both his elevated viewpoint and attentive observation.

findings.highlight: I can’t analyze its structure and project it.
findings.evidenceJa: その構造を解析し投影する事しかできない
findings.governingReading: Although Shirou cannot comprehend the theory, all he can do is analyze the structure and project it.
findings.explanation: The English inserts a negation and reverses the one capability the Japanese explicitly preserves.

findings.highlight: It’s alien technology.
findings.evidenceJa: 異星というより異星系
findings.governingReading: The governing principle is not merely like another planet but like another star system.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes a technology label and removes the escalating spatial comparison.

findings.highlight: My eyes are burned out, my brains are burned out.
findings.evidenceJa: 焼き切れた眼球、焼き切れた脳神経
findings.governingReading: Shirou reaches with burned-out eyeballs and burned-out cranial nerves.
findings.explanation: The English replaces cranial nerves with the anatomically malformed plural “brains.”

findings.highlight: a flawless blade works
findings.evidenceJa: 非の打ち所のない剣製
findings.governingReading: Illya praises the act of sword manufacture or sword Projection as flawless.
findings.explanation: “A flawless blade works” is grammatically malformed and fails to express the process she is praising.

findings.highlight: Rin’s going to try to use the second
findings.evidenceJa: リンは若輩の身でありながら第二を駆使しよう
findings.governingReading: Although still a young and inexperienced practitioner, Rin is attempting to wield the Second.
findings.explanation: The English removes the exceptional contrast between Rin’s junior status and the True Magic she will attempt to wield.

findings.highlight: multi-dimensional refractory phenomenon
findings.evidenceJa: 多重次元屈折現象
findings.governingReading: The formal description is a multidimensional refraction phenomenon.
findings.explanation: “Refractory” means resistant or difficult to treat and mistranslates the optical and dimensional mechanism of refraction.

findings.highlight: I get dizzy.
findings.evidenceJa: 気を抜くと目の前が霞む
findings.governingReading: When Shirou relaxes his guard, the view before him clouds over.
findings.explanation: The English replaces a specific visual failure with generic dizziness.

findings.highlight: My memory’s vague.
findings.evidenceJa: 記憶がとんでいる。
findings.governingReading: A portion of Shirou’s memory has vanished or skipped out.
findings.explanation: “Vague” weakens an actual discontinuity in memory into ordinary indistinct recollection.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka grabs me.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂が飛びついてくる。
findings.governingReading: Rin springs or leaps at Shirou despite appearing startlingly slow to him.
findings.explanation: The English keeps only the eventual grab and removes the abrupt movement that contrasts with his slowed perception.

findings.highlight: Why did I pick it up?
findings.evidenceJa: 何処でだろう。
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot remember where he picked the pendant up.
findings.explanation: The English changes a missing location into a missing reason for taking the object.

findings.highlight: It’s something I shouldn’t forget
findings.evidenceJa: 簡単な、忘れられない事なのに
findings.governingReading: It should be a simple event intrinsically impossible to forget.
findings.explanation: The English changes the paradox of inaccessible unforgettable memory into a moral or practical obligation not to forget.

findings.highlight: walks off with Illya
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤの手を掴んで歩き出した
findings.governingReading: Rin grabs Illya’s hand and starts walking.
findings.explanation: The English preserves joint departure but removes Rin’s sudden physical initiative.

findings.highlight: bad temper borders on outright hostility
findings.evidenceJa: 不機嫌さはほとんど殺気だった
findings.governingReading: Rin’s displeasure is almost killing intent.
findings.explanation: “Outright hostility” removes the nearly murderous intensity of her warning about Shirou’s bleeding hand.
